text: FOOTNOTES > Office of Administrative Hearings Costs

FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$13,310,600 and 105.6 FTE Positions from the Registrar of Contractors Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Office of Administrative Hearings Costs

The Baseline includes \$1,017,600 from the Registrar of Contractors Fund in FY 2027 for Office of Administrative Hearings (OAH) Costs. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

Monies in this line item are transferred from the Registrar of Contractors to OAH for services provided by OAH.
